response.query: Provide studies relevant to: Analytical errors in the laboratory of a general hospital of the Thai Red Cross Society: a 3-year experience, topics discussed:
response.answer: A 3-year study in a Thai hospital lab identified common analytical errors, focusing on improving lab quality assurance and reducing mistakes. Key areas included pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical phases. The study emphasized the importance of training and equipment calibration.
